name: Brazil
sources: World Bank has 1990 GDP at $385bn and 149.1m people, with CPI inflation of 2948% — the year of the Collor Plan. The World Bank's 1990 deposit rate for Brazil is 9394%. Output fell 4.3% over the year (IBGE).

Nothing here scripts that plan: the game opens in January, ten weeks before Collor took office and froze prices and confiscated the savings accounts. What the start state carries is the position he inherited — prices doubling every six weeks, and a nominal rate chasing them. The disinflation is left to the sim's central bank, which is the same treatment Yugoslavia gets.

THE TWO FIGURES ABOVE ARE NOT THE TRANSCRIBED PRINTS. inflation 2.95 is not 2948%; interest_rate 2.9 is not 9394%. The convention everywhere else in this directory is fraction-of-1 (Turkey's 0.603 is 60.3%), so on that convention these would read 29.48 and 93.94. They are stand-ins, and this note exists because the file previously stated the sources above beside numbers that contradicted them.

Why they are stand-ins, measured rather than asserted. Entering 29.48 and 93.94 does not degrade the run, it ends it: Brazil's GDP reaches +inf inside the first simulated year and twelve of the fifty-five tests fail. The cause is in economy.rs — the demand channel is linear and unbounded in the distance of the real rate from neutral, at a coefficient of 0.55 to annual growth, so a real rate of +64 is roughly -3500% annual growth, and 1.0 + growth/12.0 takes GDP through zero every month. Inflation is separately hard-clamped into -0.05..=3.0, so 29.48 would be discarded in month one regardless. Since this commit the loader refuses the corrected pair outright, with the ceiling named.

What the stand-ins are NOT is a designed damping, and the file should not pretend otherwise. Three things say so. First, the scale is a power of ten applied to exactly the three nations whose 1990 percentage needed four digits — Brazil, Poland and Yugoslavia — and to no others; Turkey at 60.3% and Vietnam at 67% are transcribed correctly. That is a decimal shift, not a policy. Second, a damping chosen to preserve the economics would preserve the sign of the real rate: the truth is a policy rate 6400 points above inflation, about as contractionary as a central bank can be, and 2.9 against 2.95 is five points BELOW inflation, which the model reads as easy money. Third, 2.9 is above the ceiling of 0.45 that politics.rs clamps the AI central bank's desired rate to, so the entered rate is transient anyway: it decays with a half-life of about four months and is down to 50% by January 1992.

The cost of the stand-ins, stated so nobody has to rediscover it. On seed 1 Brazil grows 13.9% through 1990 and reaches $530bn by the end of 1991, against an actual contraction of 4.3% followed by roughly flat. The sign of Brazil's early nineties is wrong, and it is wrong because of the real rate these two numbers imply, not because of anything the model does with hyperinflation as such. Fixing it means bounding the real-rate channel in economy.rs; bounding it at +/-0.20 was tried and costs china_growth_miracle (China runs to 17.1x in 30 years) and the trade-integration test, so it is a recalibration and not a one-line change. Until that is done these numbers stay and this note stays with them.
Oil: Petrobras pumped 0.63 mbd from Campos against 1.4 mbd of demand, so Brazil was buying, not selling.

note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

ALL 48 OF THE 1990-ELIGIBLE TECHNOLOGIES WERE RULED FOR THIS NATION, one at a time, against a standard published per technology rather than per country. 4 were held and are listed below with their citations; 44 were refused. The refused ids are named at the end of this note so that a reader can tell a cell that was examined and refused from a cell nobody looked at - those are different claims and the schema would otherwise flatten them into the same silence.

RULED AND REFUSED, ids only (the reasoning for each refusal is held with the board that wrote it, one standard per technology): core_cmos_submicron, core_packet_internetworking, core_single_mode_fiber, core_carbon_composites, core_combined_cycle_turbine, core_pcr, comp_microprocessor, comp_risc_superscalar, comp_relational_database, comm_fibre_optic_backbone, comm_geostationary_comsat, comm_cellular_analogue, ener_seismic_3d_imaging, ener_horizontal_drilling, ener_gas_turbine_combined_cycle, ener_crystalline_silicon_module, matl_semiconductor_lithography, matl_composite_structures, matl_industrial_robotics, matl_lean_production, matl_single_crystal_superalloy, matl_rare_earth_magnet, matl_stereolithography, aero_precision_munitions, aero_pulse_doppler_radar, aero_stealth_shaping, aero_quiet_submarine, aero_recon_satellite, bio_recombinant_pharma, bio_universal_immunisation, bio_cross_sectional_imaging, bio_conjugate_vaccine, bio_monoclonal_antibody, bio_automated_sequencing, tran_container_intermodal, tran_post_panamax_ship, tran_electronic_freight_documents, tran_high_speed_rail, agri_drip_irrigation, agri_composite_membrane, agri_protected_cultivation, agri_tissue_culture_propagation, agri_marine_aquaculture, agri_flue_gas_desulphurisation.

granted.source: Telebras' research centre CPqD launched the Tropico R digital exchange, capacity 10,000 subscribers, in 1984 (Revista Pesquisa FAPESP, 'Pioneering in telephony'); the Tropico digital switching systems were the most successful of the CPqD/local-firm projects of the 1980s and the first Brazilian-produced digital exchanges. Note that R3 does NOT support this cell - Brazil's first cellular network opened in December 1990 - so it rests on the Tropico line alone.

The Pastoral da Crianca, founded by Zilda Arns Neumann at Florestopolis in Parana in 1983, built a national community child-survival method on home-made oral rehydration solution (soro caseiro) and growth monitoring delivered by trained lay volunteers, and spread across Brazil through the 1980s; it is the largest volunteer child-survival programme of its kind and the standard citation for ORT at scale in Latin America. The Ministry of Health's diarrhoeal disease programme carried ORS in parallel.

Plantio direto began in Brazil at Rolandia, Parana in 1972, and the national area series runs 232,000 ha in 1982, the first million hectares reached in 1991 and 1.35 million ha in 1992 (Embrapa, 'Evolucao do SPD no Brasil'; FEBRAPDP historical series - the federation itself organised in 1992 on the back of farmer exchange groups already operating). At 1 Jan 1990 Brazil held the bulk of the 670,000 ha across the Mercosur countries in 1987 that this entry's own comment reads its 1990 floor off (spheres-sim/src/tech/agriculture.rs:70-74).

Embrapa's MIP-Soja (Manejo Integrado de Pragas da Soja) was launched in 1975 and coordinated from the Centro Nacional de Pesquisa de Soja, now Embrapa Soja; the programme cut insecticide applications from about nine per season to two with no loss of productivity, and was extended nationally through the state rural-extension services (Embrapa, MIP-Soja; Embrapa Soja, Documentos 143, 'Manejo Integrado de Pragas (MIP) na Cultura da Soja').
